messages:
alex: Quick thread — thought experiment: if we push enrichment (billing keys, tenant attrs) to pre-ingest and emit a slim envelope, what's the realistic impact on ad-hoc query hit-rate / analyst workflows vs expected ingest cost savings?

maria: Short answer: we save a chunk on egress and storage, but lose attribute resolution for latejoins. that's the tradeoff. :thinking_face:

tanvi: We ran a week-long sim on staging traces with 10M traces/day. Pre-enrich reduced per-day bytes by ~34% and ingest cost ~28%. However query hit-rate (fuzzy join metrics for billing lookups) dropped ~12% for ad-hoc queries where the key was only resolvable post-enrich.

kevin: Data point — the queries failing were mostly dev/debug and long-tail dashboards. Owned SLO dashboards (top 200 metric views) remained 98% intact. So product impact might be small but analysts will be hit.

maria: Proposed middleground: emit two envelopes for a short retention window: slim envelope in hot path + full envelope forwarded to cold storage/backfill pipeline. That keeps real-time cost down while preserving fidelity for historical queries.

alex: How would that affect cost attribution? Our billing pipelines need the billing_key on ingest to tag tokens. If we keep billing_key only in cold/backfill, attribution would be delayed — does that break usage-based dashboards?

tanvi: Yes — immediate attribution would be off. We could emit a lightweight billing_key index (small kv blob) on ingest to satisfy attribution: {"trace_id":"...","billing_key":"..."} — tiny 200B per trace. That keeps cost low and keeps attribution real-time.

kevin: Ops concern: more moving parts. Backfills + late joins are messy. Also need to keep deterministic id mapping so backfills can reconcile. ops-bot: I created infra ticket #1234 to track reconciliation tasks.

maria: Another option: selective pre-enrich — only pre-enrich traces that match hot cohorts (top customers, SLO-critical services). Rest follow lazy enrich. That reduces cardinality explosion.

alex: Agree. Next steps: tanvi to share sim dashboard + scripts; kevin to propose reconciliation playbook (idempotent backfill flow); maria to draft RFC addendum with cost numbers and hybrid options. Plan to sync Wed 10am.

ops-bot: Reminder set for Wed 10:00. :calendar:
